definitions.short: Naarah , the name of an Israelitess, and of a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H5292. Naarah II. [ נַעֲרָה ] proper name, of a location on border of Ephraim — only with ה locative, נַעֲרָ֫תָה Josh 16:7 ( ᵐ5 αἱ Κῶμαι αὐτῶν ; ᵐ5 L id. + Αναραθα ); apparently = נַעֲרָן , q. v. below; Νοοραθ lay 5 Roman miles from Jericho Lag Onom. 283, 11 compare Buhl Geogr. 181 . III. נַעֲרָה proper name, feminine in Judah 1Chr 4:5-6 , (twice in verse); ᵐ5 Θωαδα , A Νοορα , ᵐ5 L Νοερα .
